issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Stock.findStockIngredient: the problem statement UML and the solution implementation declare a single-parameter method "public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name)", but the template defines "public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive)". In the template, other Stock methods (add, take) call findStockIngredient(String) (one-parameter), which will not compile against the two-parameter template signature. This inconsistency will cause compilation failures and confuses students about the API they must implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template API match the problem statement and solution by providing the single-parameter signature. Either change the existing template method to: public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) { ... } (implement exact-name lookup as in the solution) or add an overload: public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) { return findStockIngredient(name, true /*or false as intended*/); } Ensure all internal calls (add, take, and other callers) use the provided single-parameter method so the project compiles and students follow the API described in the exercise.
